status: design proposal only; not approved or implemented
requirements: P02-GATE-AC07 and FAIL-58: genuine selected engine-host occupancy, ultimate specific failure even after accepted receipt, no shadow stack, no deletion/foreign attachment.
L01: actual OS lease/reinspection; PID, timeout or stale metadata never authorizes takeover.
L02: interactive10s, owner60s; no ready on timeout or orphaned startup.
L04: full authenticated actual status over NATS; historical CONTROL is separate and never readiness.
NATS remains all runtime application communication; any new bootstrap-only persistence is an explicit architectural decision.

gaps.fact: All nonzero Docker command exits reduce to command_failed; stdout/stderr do not establish port cause.
Accepted CONTROL is emitted after protected preparation but before selected broker inspection and later StartOwned.
Exactly one <=4096 frame plus writer EOF is required; reader consumes/closes it.
Exactly one attempted receipt; accepted cannot later become a failure frame.
After creator departure, a subsequent caller has no exact creator pipe capability; broker absence prevents authenticated HOST reply.

occupancyAdmission.apiProposal: private selectedHostPortObservation(ctx, admitted selection) error; no arbitrary address/port/helper callback
occupancyAdmission.authority: Derive only127.0.0.1 TCP port from fully admitted profile/Compose; full selected-engine private authority first; actual transient bootstrap lease excludes competing mutation; skip known owned-running broker. Repeat at locked StartOwned boundary.
occupancyAdmission.observation: Prefer a real selected-host TCP listener query or completed TCP connection without application bytes. A successful connect establishes a listener at that moment. Do not call a successful temporary bind a guarantee of later availability.
occupancyAdmission.native: Use actual native host socket APIs only on qualified native Linux/macOS. NativeUnix under WSL is not Windows host proof; refuse unsupported mapping.
occupancyAdmission.windows: Use a fixed separately trusted Windows-host helper/OS API, with loopback and validated integer port, bounded closed result, no profiles/user scripts/raw stderr. Existing Docker executable pin does not automatically enroll PowerShell. New helper trust/ownership qualification is required.
occupancyAdmission.errors: Only actual observed listener -> trusted selected_port_occupied. Unknown/timeout/reserved-port/access failures -> probe_unavailable or unconfirmed, never fabricated occupation/permission/pull category.
occupancyAdmission.budgets: Use remaining original frontend/owner context, no extra budget; exact owned sockets/helper process closed and joined, cleanup causes retained.
occupancyAdmission.race: A clear probe is not a reservation; a listener appearing after the probe needs fresh observation for its eventual failure classification. No kill/commandeer of that listener.

options.name: preflight only
options.reason: TOCTOU remains and failures after accepted cannot reach departed caller.

options.name: second CONTROL frame
options.decision: not sufficient alone; larger transport change
options.reason: Breaks current EOF/single-frame/read-once invariant, and cannot reach later caller after creator pipe closes. Would need explicit protocol/version/ownership review.

options.name: existing authenticated NATS failure reply
options.reason: Existing terminal-failure window preserves genuine failure and exact owner cleanup; it cannot serve through an absent selected broker or another listener.

options.name: bounded private terminal bootstrap receipt under existing enrollment boundary
options.decision: smallest complete proposal, requires explicit new exception approval
options.reason: Keep current one-shot pipe unchanged. Persist only actual joined bootstrap terminal outcome, separately from enrollment and health records. This can serve a still-present or later authorized caller when NATS absent, as diagnostic-only historical control.

proposedTerminalReceipt.boundary: A dedicated fixed <=4096 control artifact in the already private enrolled profile, opened via existing canonical no-follow/owner/ACL checks. Never overwrite profile.json/status-owner.json or business/health state.
proposedTerminalReceipt.producer: Only concrete Run-owned operation after actual completion/join with actual cold invocation, actual held service lease, current independently enrolled owner/profile/runtime/release/config/engine bindings. No caller-supplied failure or arbitrary writer/filename.
proposedTerminalReceipt.content: Closed version/kind/full binding/invocation/completion-time/outcome/static diagnostic category only. No passwords, private paths, counts, snapshots, PIDs, commands, subscription or readiness.
proposedTerminalReceipt.read: Fresh owner/profile revalidation from independent policy, exact binding/revision, closed JSON, bounded size, regular single-link file, real owner/private ACL. Reject stale enrollment/release, symlink/hardlink, malformed/unknown fields, future time and unrecognized replacement/generation. Define age/retention policy explicitly before code.
proposedTerminalReceipt.replacement: Publish atomically only while actual service lease held, with exact expected prior generation; new actual terminal success must supersede old failure without asserting readiness. Do not overwrite unrelated/unknown state.
proposedTerminalReceipt.semantics: Prefer NATS actual status. Missing/malformed/untrusted control artifact never becomes known failed/ready. Historical failure cannot authorize startup/stop/adoption or block a new compatible ensure indefinitely. New ensures still perform genuine current preflight; current pending requires NATS or exact owned pipe, never this record.
proposedTerminalReceipt.cleanup: Record actual incomplete cleanup as unknown/incomplete, never claim resources reaped from bootstrap join alone. Existing concrete Session/dialer errors and service-lease transfer remain retained; persistence failure itself is closed and owned, not hidden.
proposedTerminalReceipt.trustLimit: Same-UID local owner trust is explicit; this file cannot prove isolation from a malicious same-UID plugin. If stronger producer authenticity is required, separately enrolled signing capability is required rather than invented trust from recorded digest.
proposedTerminalReceipt.approval: This is new bootstrap-only control persistence, not an already accepted use of enrollment metadata. Root must approve schema/trust/staleness/atomicity/pattern and NATS exception before implementation.

regressionCoverage: Actual native listener positive and clear port control; Windows actual selected-host listener positive; WSL-only listener must not be misclassified as Windows evidence.
Unknown/reserved/access/timeout/helper failure cannot produce occupied; fixed result parser rejects arbitrary stdout/stderr, host/address/port mismatch and forged helper result.
Existing owned-running broker warm reuse bypasses foreign-port check; two concurrent callers converge1; exact lease release and helper/socket cancellation/join.
Deterministic clear->listener-before-StartOwned race: unchanged bound, no shadow stack, terminal diagnostic from genuine observation; generic command_failed remains unclassified.
Actual accepted receipt followed by genuine failed Bootstrap when NATS absent: caller before departure and later authenticated status receive bounded static historical failure, no L04 ready/counts.

Private terminal artifact binding/replacement/stale/owner/ACL/symlink/hardlink/malformed/unknown-field/future-time negatives; later success supersedes old failure; new compatible retry remains possible.
Typed cleanup failure during terminal publication/Run cleanup retains exact Session/socket/lease recovery owner; no scalar cause loss.
Actual installed occupied selected-engine case with original10/60/5 budgets and retained full container/network/volume baseline; supported native Linux/macOS/WSL qualification required.
limits: No source edits, product tests, Go builds, Docker calls, resource changes or phase acceptance in this design review.
Current accepted one-frame receipt invariants remain unchanged.
This proposal does not close missing Docker/Compose/permission/pull or other FAIL-57/59 cases.
